title: Edge Detection Explorer with Convolution from Scratch
description: Implements convolution by hand, applies Sobel, Laplacian and Gaussian kernels to photographs and lets learners edit kernel values to see how each number changes the filtered result.

title: Histogram Equalisation and Contrast Enhancement Lab
description: Implements histogram stretching and equalisation, applies them to under- and over-exposed photographs and compares the results with the adaptive version, noting where noise gets amplified.

title: Template Matching Part Finder for a Workbench Camera
description: Locates known tools on a workbench in a fixed camera view by template matching, handling lighting changes and small rotations, and reports where matching fails so learners understand its limits.

title: Colour-Blind Simulation and Palette Checker
description: Simulates the main types of colour vision deficiency on any image and checks whether a chosen chart palette stays distinguishable, suggesting safer alternatives where it does not.

title: Crop Row Detection from Tractor Camera Video
description: Finds crop rows in field video using vegetation segmentation and line fitting, outputs a steering offset for each frame and evaluates it against hand-marked rows across growth stages.

title: Rail Track Obstruction Detection from a Cab Camera
description: Segments the rails in forward-facing video, defines a danger zone ahead and detects objects inside it, with latency and false-alarm analysis against the braking distance a train actually needs.

title: Document Image Quality Gate for a Scanning App
description: Scores a photographed page for blur, glare, skew and low resolution before OCR, and tells the user in plain words what to fix, validated against how much each issue degrades text recognition.

title: Pedestrian Crossing Counter with Privacy by Design
description: Counts people crossing at a junction from overhead video without storing frames, blurring faces at capture and exporting only aggregate counts per interval, with an audit of what leaves the device.

title: Stereo Camera Distance Estimator
description: Calibrates a pair of cameras, computes disparity maps and converts them to metric distance, comparing measured and true distances and showing how error grows with range. Includes a printed checkerboard calibration guide.

title: Satellite Image Change Detection for Urban Growth
description: Aligns satellite images from two years, detects new built-up areas with both index thresholds and a learned model, and quantifies agreement with a manually digitised reference.
